column1: # Shade emoji synonym bridge — generated by scripts/gen_emoji_synonyms.py.

# users type that the corpus does NOT already cover; targets are best-first.
# EmojiSearch expands unmatched queries through this bridge (Gboard uses an
# on-device Gemma embedding tier for the same job; we stay model-free).
